title: 姚明：篮球连接中美，年轻人放学就打球
speaker: Yao Ming

segments.en: I know this FIFA World Cup now is probably a top headline for all in use for today, but I have to say that basketball is shorter to shorter than China to compare to football or soccer, what a way to call.
segments.zh: 我知道现在世界杯是头条新闻，但我必须说，篮球在中国比足球更普及。

segments.en: And that influences so many of the young generation that they play on basketball for you every day after school.
segments.zh: 这影响了非常多的年轻人，他们每天放学后都打篮球。

segments.en: Sometimes they skip school for that.
segments.zh: 有时候他们甚至逃学去打球。

segments.en: And to the afternoon, there's many young fellow who joined the ND.
segments.zh: 到了下午，有很多年轻人加入了ND（NBA发展联盟）。

segments.en: Last year we have a young player called Yang Hansen, who joined Portland Trailblazers.
segments.zh: 去年我们有一个年轻球员叫杨瀚森，他加入了波特兰开拓者队。

segments.en: I'm sure there's a many young player like him to reach their sky, hopefully here in the next few years.
segments.zh: 我相信还有很多像他一样的年轻球员能够实现梦想，希望就在未来几年。

segments.en: So, basketball really, really connecting us together on the same field, and that's the magic of it.
segments.zh: 所以，篮球真的把我们连接在同一个赛场上，这就是它的魔力。
